columns.status: Current order status. Complete = delivered and kept; Returned = sent back; Cancelled = never fulfilled; Shipped = in transit; Processing = not yet shipped.
columns.gender: Customer's gender, copied from the customer record. Not the product department.
columns.returned_at: When the order was returned. Null unless returned.
columns.shipped_at: When the order shipped. Null if not yet shipped or cancelled.
columns.delivered_at: When the order was delivered. Null if not yet delivered.
columns.num_of_item: Number of items in the order.

order_items.description: One row per item sold. The main table for revenue, cost and return analysis.

columns.inventory_item_id: Physical inventory unit shipped. Not needed for most analysis.
columns.status: Status of this item: Complete, Returned, Cancelled, Shipped or Processing. Items in one order can differ.
columns.returned_at: When the item was returned. Null unless returned.
columns.sale_price: Price the customer paid for this item, in USD. Revenue is based on this.

products.description: Product catalog: one row per product.

columns.cost: Unit cost to the company, in USD. Gross margin = sale_price - cost.
columns.category: Product category, e.g. Jeans, Swim, Accessories.
columns.name: Product name.
columns.brand: Brand name. There is no separate supplier field.
columns.retail_price: List price in USD. The price actually paid is order_items.sale_price.
columns.department: Men or Women: the department the product is sold in.

columns.first_name: Customer first name (personal data: do not show in dashboards).
columns.last_name: Customer last name (personal data: do not show in dashboards).
columns.email: Customer email (personal data: do not show in dashboards).
columns.traffic_source: Marketing channel the customer came from when they signed up. One value per customer, not per order.
columns.created_at: When the customer account was created (UTC).

_rules._about: Business rules the audit checks. Written by the analyst; the checks themselves are generic.
